card.name: Verbs of adding more, before 'additional'
card.fires_on: Verbs like add, added, administer, or the article an, right where the next word is likely 'additional', 'the remainder' or 'more'. Seen in dosing steps, reconstitution directions and procedure steps.

modes.label: Give more drug
modes.description: Administer or dose verb when a further dose is called for.
modes.example: If the response to an opioid overdose reversal agent is suboptimal or only brief in nature,<< administer>> additional reversal agent as directed by the product

modes.label: Add the rest of a liquid
modes.description: Add as an instruction to put in the remaining water or another component.
modes.example: Add approximately half the total amount of water for reconstitution and shake well.<< Add>> the remainder of water and shake well.

modes.label: Added element in a procedure
modes.description: Verb for adding a part or item outside dosing.
modes.example: On the basis of the analysis, the team<< added>> rubber damper restraints at the base
